meaning: Friendly welcoming gesture to invite someone in or express hospitality.
hand_configuration: Both open palms facing upward, sweeping gently inward toward the chest with welcoming facial expression.
isl_grammar_structure: Social discourse opening / polite greeting marker (Topic-Comment lexical sign).
cultural_linguistic_notes: Widely used in public reception counters, hospitals, and educational sign discourse across India.

media.description: Both open palms sweeping toward chest in hospitality.

source: ISLRTC Supplementary Vocabulary - Conversational Social Signs

hand_configuration: Dominant hand forms an 'F' or pinched 'O' shape holding imaginary cup handle, moving to mouth with sipping head motion.
isl_grammar_structure: Noun: acts as direct object in food/drink desire expressions (e.g. ME TEA WANT).
cultural_linguistic_notes: Chai is a universal cultural fixture in Indian daily life; commonly used at hospitality counters and offices.

media.description: Hand miming holding teacup handle moving toward mouth.

meaning: Pharmaceutical tablet, prescription pills, or therapeutic medication.
hand_configuration: Dominant middle finger tip grinds circularly in the center of the non-dominant open flat palm (mortar and pestle grinding motion).
isl_grammar_structure: Medical lexical noun; used in imperative triage requests (e.g. MEDICINE NEED).
cultural_linguistic_notes: Essential medical sign recognized across Indian hospitals and health clinics.

media.description: Middle finger circular grinding on flat open palm mimicking preparation of medicine.

meaning: Expressing regret, apology, or request for pardon.
hand_configuration: Dominant hand forms an 'A' closed fist making circular rubbing motion clockwise over center of chest with contrite facial expression.
isl_grammar_structure: Polite discourse interjection; placed initial or final in remedial communication.
cultural_linguistic_notes: Chest contact signifies remorse originating from the heart in Indian sign linguistics.

media.description: Fist rubbing circularly on center of chest in apology.

meaning: Polite particle used to make a respectful request.
hand_configuration: Flat open dominant palm placed flat on upper chest, stroking downward gently with slight forward head bow.
isl_grammar_structure: Modality marker: attaches before or after request predicate (e.g. HELP PLEASE).
cultural_linguistic_notes: Essential social register marker used when requesting aid or services at public counters.

media.description: Flat palm smoothing downward on chest in courteous plea.

meaning: Immediate cessation of motion, activity, or dangerous action.
hand_configuration: Dominant flat open hand comes down sharply, pinky-edge first, onto flat horizontal non-dominant palm, halting abruptly.
isl_grammar_structure: Imperative directive; marked by sudden spatial deceleration and alert facial non-manual marker.
cultural_linguistic_notes: Critical safety sign in transit, public spaces, and emergency evacuation.

media.description: Dominant hand striking downward into open palm to signal an immediate halt.

hand_configuration: Both index fingers pointing upwards facing each other, brought together until index knuckles touch (MEET), followed by thumbs up (GOOD / HAPPY).
isl_grammar_structure: Compound idiom: [MEET] [GOOD] with reciprocal spatial directionality.
cultural_linguistic_notes: Standard respectful opening during new introductions among signers in India.

media.description: Two index fingers converging together to represent two people meeting, followed by approval.

source: ISLRTC Section 1: Common Greetings & Social Conversational Idioms

meaning: Emergency medical transport vehicle with flashing siren.
hand_configuration: Curved open dominant hand positioned above head rotating circularly, mimicking flashing beacon light, combined with driving motion.
isl_grammar_structure: Urgent noun topic; triggers priority hospital dispatch syntax in triage.
cultural_linguistic_notes: Recognized nationwide by emergency response teams and deaf dispatchers.

media.description: Rotating open palm over head representing flashing emergency beacon.

meaning: Currency, cash, currency notes, or financial payment.
hand_configuration: Dominant thumb rubs repeatedly against the tips of the index and middle fingers in a cash counting / banknote rubbing gesture.
isl_grammar_structure: Quantitative / Transactional noun; used in counter questions (e.g. MONEY HOW-MUCH?).
cultural_linguistic_notes: Standard transactional sign across Indian retail, banks, and post offices.

media.description: Thumb rubbing index and middle fingers in banknote transaction gesture.

meaning: Household, parents and children family unit.
hand_configuration: Both hands form 'F' or cupped handshapes with fingertips touching at midline, then circling outward and touching wrists together to represent a complete household circle.
isl_grammar_structure: Collective noun; acts as discourse topic in social introductions (e.g. MY FAMILY BIG).
cultural_linguistic_notes: Central concept in Indian social communication; implies deep community and familial bonds.

media.description: Both hands tracing an outward circle touching fingertips and wrists representing an enclosed family unit.
